notes: BaZi's classical case charts cannot yet serve as golden examples: the Sanming Tonghui work page warns that later commercial printings INSERTED late-Ming official charts, so any case chart is untrustworthy until edition control resolves the interpolation problem. That is a documented finding, not an assumption. What CAN be verified now are the structural consequences of the doctrine itself - relations that must hold for every chart if the tables are correct - plus the sexagenary day anchor against an independent published date.

examples.work: Sexagenary day count, independent anchor verification
examples.location: Two published day-pillar identities separated by 18354 days
examples.description: The day anchor is a product choice (no concordance source is registered), so it must reproduce a SECOND independently published day identity. 1949-10-01 is a Jia-Zi day; 2000-01-01 is a Wu-Wu day. An anchor fitted to one and wrong on the other would be caught here.

claims.author_states: JDN 2433191 (1949-10-01) is a Jia-Zi day, sexagenary index 0.
JDN 2451545 (2000-01-01) is a Wu-Wu day, sexagenary index 54.

examples.location: Sanming Tonghui juan 1, stem-branch and Na Yin material
examples.description: Schools differ on middle and residual qi, but no school disputes that a branch's MAIN hidden stem carries the branch's own element. If that identity fails for any of the twelve branches, the hidden-stem table is corrupt - and every month-command and rooting judgment built on it is void.

claims.author_states: For all twelve branches, the element of the main hidden stem equals the element of the branch itself.
The four cardinal branches Zi, Mao, You each carry exactly one hidden stem (pure qi).

examples.description: The Ten Gods are defined by five element relations crossed with polarity agreement. Structural consequences: every day master must generate exactly ten distinct relations across the ten stems; a stem must relate to itself as Friend (bi jian); and the same-element opposite-polarity stem must be Rob Wealth (jie cai).

claims.author_states: Each of the ten possible day masters yields ten distinct Ten-God relations across the ten stems.
A stem relates to itself as Friend (bi jian).
The same-element, opposite-polarity stem is Rob Wealth (jie cai).

examples.location: Yuanhai Ziping, month-command and seasonal-depth material
examples.description: In any month, the five elements must occupy the five command states exactly once each - one prosperous, one assisting, one resting, one imprisoned, one dead. A table that assigns two elements the same state, or leaves a state empty, is wrong.

claims.author_states: For each of the twelve month branches, the five elements map onto the five command states bijectively.
In every month the season's own element stands prosperous (wang).
